#+TITLE: Verbatim Integrity Demo

An example block is literal — org-like lines are NOT interpreted:

#+BEGIN_EXAMPLE
- this stays a dash, not a list
* this stays an asterisk, not a heading
/no italics here/
#+END_EXAMPLE

A verse block preserves its line breaks:

#+BEGIN_VERSE
Roses are red
Violets are blue
#+END_VERSE

Source code keeps every character verbatim:

#+BEGIN_SRC text
| pipes | stay |
+ plus stays
#+END_SRC
